channel.content:encoded: The Office co-stars and best friends, Jenna Fischer and Angela Kinsey, are doing the ultimate The Office re-watch podcast for you. Each week Jenna and Angela will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind the scene stories that only two people who were there, can tell you.

item.title: 20th Anniversary of The Office with Greg Daniels
item.description:
This week on Office Ladies 6.0, we celebrate the 20th Anniversary of “The Office” with Greg Daniels! Greg shares how he got his job on The Office and how he hoped to change the style of American TV comedies. He also reveals an item of Pam's he still has and a “midnight snack” that he learned to make from his young nephew. This is a very fun episode and a great way to honor this big milestone for “The Office”. So please enjoy this episode with our favorite yarn salesman! 

﻿
